dogecoin.text: I tried to orange-pill this doctor I know. He told me I was delusional for thinking #Bitcoin has any potential. BTC was $7,000 at the time. Then he admitted I was right after BTC pumped. But instead of buying BTC, he bought Dogecoin at 70 cents. Rekt. I don't think he likes me.
What flummoxes me is that the notorious shitcoiner who pumped Dogecoin to 70 cents with his stupid tweets is now considered a savior by the Bitcoin *Maximalist* community. Talking about Elon Musk.
